    assert r['safety']['valid'] is True
    assert r['execution']['allowed'] is False
    assert (p/'.kobra-plot-job').is_file()
    b=r['geometry']['output_bounds']
    assert 8 <= b['min_x'] <= b['max_x'] <= 218
    assert 41 <= b['min_y'] <= b['max_y'] <= 225
    g=(p/'output.gcode').read_text()
    for token in ['G28','G91','M104','M109','M140','M190',' E']:
        assert token not in g, (p, token)
    print(p.name, json.dumps({'polylines': r['geometry']['polylines'], 'points': r['geometry']['points'], 'bounds': b, 'duration_s': r['geometry'].get('nominal_duration_seconds')}, sort_keys=True))
